provenance.evidence_masking: Both evidence-masked model policies remove diagnoses rejected by check_terminal_evidence on visible state only

laya_action_question.instructions: Choose exactly one next workflow action using the report and observations available so far.

choices.name: Check storage
choices.description: Run the storage capacity and write check.

choices.name: Database failure
choices.description: Conclude that current evidence supports a database failure.

choices.name: Authentication failure
choices.description: Conclude that current evidence supports an authentication failure.

choices.name: Disk full
choices.description: Conclude that current evidence supports exhausted storage.

choices.name: Healthy
choices.description: Conclude that all required current checks support healthy operation.

choices.name: Request review
choices.description: Request human review when the available evidence is insufficient or ambiguous.

laya_action_question.input_format_note: Laya receives its native named-choice question; GLiClass receives an ordered candidate-name list. The model-family comparison does not isolate architecture from native input format.
